page_dashboard_home_description: This starter kit is ready. Add your application code and routes under src.
selfie_capture_camera_busy: Another app uses the camera. Close the other app or select a photo file.
selfie_capture_camera_denied: The camera permission is off. Select a photo file instead.
selfie_capture_camera_failed: The camera did not start. Try again or select a photo file.
selfie_capture_camera_idle: Start the camera to take a selfie.
selfie_capture_camera_missing: This device has no camera. Select a photo file instead.
selfie_capture_camera_ready: The camera is on. Take the selfie.
selfie_capture_camera_unavailable: The camera is not available. Select a photo file instead.
selfie_capture_capture_failed: The selfie did not save. Try again.
selfie_capture_file_failed: The photo did not load. Select another file.
selfie_capture_file_hint: The app shrinks the photo to 720 pixels and removes the metadata.
selfie_capture_location_denied: The location permission is off. You can still take the selfie.
selfie_capture_location_ready: Position found. The accuracy is {{accuracy}} meters.
selfie_capture_location_timeout: The position request timed out. Try again.
selfie_capture_location_unavailable: The position is not available. Try again.
selfie_capture_location_unsupported: This browser has no location support.
selfie_capture_photo_ready: The selfie is ready. The size is {{kilobytes}} KB.
selfie_capture_photo_too_large: The photo is too large. Select another photo.
